visualCharacteristics.layout: Full-bleed, 40vh (min 360px) at every width; black background, flex-centred content.
visualCharacteristics.image: Photo at 50% opacity, absolute, full size, object-fit cover centred (50% 50%). Eager LCP image (fetchpriority high).
visualCharacteristics.text: Centred white text box (no padding below 768; 2vw padding and max-width 1200px >= 768). h1 40px/1.1 weight 300, margin 26.8px 0 0; h2 subtitle 25px/1.1 500, margin 20.75px 0.
visualCharacteristics.buttons: Row of buttons 5px apart. Filled (bold link): #007acb, padding 13px 20px, 13.5px/500, radius 2px, hover #0065a7. Outline (italic link): transparent, 1px solid #fff, padding 12px 20px, hover background #007acb.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-top hero with a dimmed photo, a heading, subtitle and two calls to action.
visualCharacteristics.source: Compared closely with hero-dim-photo (built from /service): same family (black backdrop, 50% photo, absolute centred white text, min-height 360px, 1200px text box with 2vw padding >= 768, photo full width >= 992) but six visible differences, too many for an additive tweak without changing /service: (1) height 40vh at every width vs 60vh / 50vh (>=768) / 40vh (>=992) - on a 390x844 phone this hero is 360px, hero-dim-photo 506px; (2) photo object-position 50% 50% vs 68% 25%; (3) text box padding 0 below 768 vs 10px; (4) h1 40px/44px weight 300 (theme default) with margin 26.8px 0 0 vs weight 400 margin 26.8px 0; (5) a subtitle h2 25px/27.5px 500 white margin 20.75px 0 instead of a 16px paragraph; (6) TWO buttons: 'Choose a Plan' filled #007acb, no border, padding 13px 20px, 13.5px/500, radius 2px (136x48) + 'Contact Support' outline transparent, 1px solid #fff, padding 12px 20px (155x48), inline with ~5px gap; hero-dim-photo has one outline CTA only. Same content model as hero-dim-photo (image, imageAlt, text), so the variant can share its JS structure.

contentPattern.structure: Image row then rich-text row. Consecutive paragraphs holding only one link render side by side as buttons: bold link = filled, italic link = outline (plain link = filled).

reuseGuidance: Use for mybeckman.in inner-page heroes with a dimmed photo, h1 + subtitle and one or two buttons. For a single outline CTA and 60/50/40vh height use hero-dim-photo.
